items.title: Weddings
items.intro: From the first idea to the last guest home.

photo.alt: Long black tables covered in white flowers and candles at night

body: We design the room, then we build it: flowers, linen, furniture, lighting and the people to run the day.
Most weddings we take on are a year or more away; a smaller day can be quicker. Multi-day weddings, a mehndi, a nikah and a reception, are planned as one.

items.title: A year out: what to decide first
items.intro: Three things fix everything else. Choose them in this order.
body: The date, the number and the room decide almost every other choice. Fix the date first if it matters to you; the number next, because it rules out most rooms; then the room.
Flowers, tableware and the menu follow from those three. We start design work once they are settled.

items.title: Choosing a room
items.intro: Seated, standing and the space between tables.
body: A room's capacity is the venue's to give, and it changes with the layout: long tables seat more than rounds, standing takes more again.
Ask the venue for its plan with measurements. We draw your layout on it before you sign.

items.title: Candles, and the rules
body: Many rooms allow only enclosed flames, some none at all. We ask the venue in writing before we design around candlelight.

questions.q: Are you free on our date?
questions.a: Check it on this page: free, on hold for another client, or taken. If it's on hold, ask us and we'll tell you if it comes free.
It depends on the number of guests, the room and how far the design goes. Tell us your budget band in the brief and we'll say honestly what it can do.
A design fee, then production quoted line by line. A deposit holds your date; the rest follows the schedule in our terms.

questions.q: Can we see the room before we commit?
questions.a: Yes. Every proposal comes with design visuals of your room, a plan drawn for your number and a run of the night.

questions.q: Can you work in our venue?
questions.a: Almost always. We ask the venue for its plan and rules before we design, and we can help you find a room.

questions.q: Who is there on the day?
questions.a: Our team from load-in to hand-back, with one person as your contact throughout.
